name: kestello
description: Dev-only tooling for Kestello: build, format, lint and test. Nothing here ships or runs in production: built files are committed under */assets/build/.

scripts.format: npm run format:php && npm run format:js
scripts.format:php: composer install --quiet && sh tools/php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --show-progress=dots
scripts.lint: npm run lint:php && npm run lint:js && npm run analyse
scripts.lint:php: composer install --quiet && sh tools/php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --show-progress=none --using-cache=no
scripts.analyse: composer install --quiet && sh tools/php -d memory_limit=2G vendor/bin/phpstan analyse -c phpstan.dist.neon --no-progress
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:php
